Self-authored AP242 fixtures generated by
`cargo run --locked --manifest-path crates/Cargo.toml -p brep-core --example generate_step_v5_fixture -- <kind>`.
They contain no proprietary or external fixture data.

The checked-in set covers standard rational curve/surface composition,
millimetre/metre/inch contexts, nested rigid occurrences, one and multiple
oriented void shells, and analytic/freeform rational bodies. Complete
manifold periodic `SEAM_CURVE` fixtures remain outside the `/5` claim.
